submitted.rationale: Measured three points along the Ca≈0.21 line. EQE was 0.47% at Cu 0.54, 0.67% at Cu 0.36 (idx 91) and 0.38% at Cu 0.26. Idx 91 is the peak. It has a Cu:V ratio near 1:1, which is where copper vanadate (Cu2V2O7-like) is active under 2.72 eV light.

rejected.reason: Ca vanadates such as CaV2O6 and Ca2V2O7 likely have too wide a bandgap to absorb 2.72 eV light well. Not measured because only 3 merit measurements were allowed.
